text:
alex: Quick design check — pushed a small proto for the org settings page: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/org-settings-proto. Looking for microcopy + contrast feedback on the roles grid and the SSO toggle placement. TL;DR: need a microcopy tweak and a11y fixes.

maria: taking a look now :eyes: first pass — the secondary metadata under role names (last active / seats) is too low contrast at 12px. Fails WCAG AA for normal text. Recommend swap token from #6b6b6b -> #2b2b2b or bump weight to 500.

jordan: agree w/ contrast callout. Also the SSO control being inline with other toggles makes it visually easy to miss. Maybe surface it as a primary control near the org header: "Require SSO" with a short help link. Also noticed tab order: keyboard focus skips the role rows when using Shift+Tab.

chen: good catch on keyboard. We should add explicit tabindex and aria-describedby for the help tooltip. Example for the toggle we can use:
```html
<button id="sso-toggle" aria-label="Require SSO for this organization" aria-describedby="sso-help">Toggle</button>
```
That addresses screen reader clarity.

ursula: audit log nav thought — users expect Export and Filters next to the breadcrumb / org title. Currently Export is buried under the overflow menu which reduces discoverability. Can we move Export into the header and keep the overflow for advanced ops?

design-bot: automated accessibility scan results: 3 contrast failures (roles metadata, small label on invite chip, light divider), 1 missing aria on sso toggle, 2 keyboard-focus traps in modal. Full report: https://internal.reports/scan/1825004321. Recommend quick patch for contrast + aria before next release.

product-lead: prioritize contrast tokens and the SSO aria fix. Can someone propose 2-3 microcopy variants for the toggle so we can A/B for clarity? I'll allocate a short experiment window (48h) after we ship the patch. Ideas: "Require SSO for org", "Enforce SSO login", "Require SAML SSO".

alex: I like "Require SSO for org" — explicit and not too jargony. @maria can you prepare the color token diff? @chen please add the aria and keyboard spec to the PR.

maria: on it — will push CSS tokens (token names + new hex) and attach a screenshot before EOD.

chen: I'll add aria-label + tabindex fixes and include a keyboard nav test in the component story. Will ping for review.

ursula: Opening a ticket to move Export into the header and wire up analytics to measure click-through. Will link ticket here.

alex: Thanks all :thumbsup: Plan: small patch (contrast + aria + keyboard) this week, follow-up copy A/B next week. If anyone sees a blocker call it out here now.

jordan: minor nit — role row hover state is very subtle on high-DPI displays. Can we bump hover to 8% darker of base bg? Not blocking.

maria: noted, will include hover delta in diff.

alex: great — closing loop. If you want to add any microcopy variants drop them in this thread.
